items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I remember when Jordan Rovershoe band broke up, Jordan went playing violin with Freddie.

ctx.x: Yeah. What's that place where a friend of them used to play out at Mellon Boyd?

Play out there on Saturday and Sunday. That was an all night job. So I had four clubs, even at four in the morning. What's the name of that place? Fred's band was the oldest band played out there. It was out on one of the camps over the water. No it was right off the boat by the train running. You know? What's the name of that place? What's the name of that place? Was the place open to the public? Because when, I remember when Jordan Rovershoe band broke up, Jordan went playing violin with Freddie. Remember that?…
And there's something else in one place.
